Items.LootOffer: {killer} stands over {victim}'s body and may loot it.
Items.LootLost: {item} is left on {victim}'s body — lost forever.

Actions.NoPing: {name} has no token on this scene and no Location set.
Actions.OverseerPrompt: Choose an action for {name}, or roll on the random table.
Actions.MimicPrompt: Choose the action {name} copies, or do nothing.
Actions.NoLover: {name} has no lover set — pick one on the sheet.
Actions.LoverStatusNone: No lover set — pick one on the sheet.
Actions.LoverFoundMsg: {a} and {b} have found each other! Their rolls gain +1.
Actions.RageAnnounce: {name} learns of {lover}'s death and falls into an insatiable rage! New personality: {personality}. Their Move actions become Attacks while anyone shares their square; any teams are ignored.
Actions.RageNote: Rage: Move becomes Attack — a potential victim shares their square.
Actions.AttackNoTarget: {name} searches the area for someone to attack but finds no one, and does not move.
Actions.AttackWin: {winner} wins the exchange ({w} vs {l}). The loser rolls for damage.
Actions.MultiTargetNote: {item} sprays the area — also aimed at {names}!
Actions.SprayHit: {name} is caught in the spray ({d} vs {a}) — roll for damage.
Actions.AreaNote: Area Affect: the blast forces everyone else in the square to evade.
Actions.AreaMoveNote: {item}: no one else in the square — the Attack is played as a Move.
Actions.AreaThreshold: Evade threshold: {n}. Everyone else in the square rolls 1d6 to match or exceed it.
Actions.AreaModifierNote: Modifier effects last only until the end of the victim's next turn.
Actions.AreaHit: {name} is caught in the blast ({n} vs {t}) — roll for damage.
Actions.ConvinceFallbackNote: No one here to convince — resolve as a Search instead; they do not move.
Actions.ConvinceNoTarget: {name} finds no one left to convince — they search the area instead.
Actions.ConvinceVs: {convincer} tries to convince {target} to join forces…
Actions.ComfortSelfHeal: {name} tends their own wounds — {injury} is healed. ({total} vs {n}+)
Actions.ComfortMorale: {name} lifts {target}'s spirits — +1 on their next action. ({total} vs {n}+)
Actions.ComfortMoraleSelf: {name} steels themselves — +1 on their next action. ({total} vs {n}+)
Actions.SearchOpposed: {name} scours the area — someone is hiding here…
Actions.SearchDiscovered: {searcher} discovers {target} hiding! They are no longer hidden, and the search ends.
Actions.SearchNoOne: {name} finds no one hiding. They keep searching for items.
Actions.ItemLeft: {name} finds {item} ({affects}) but it's no upgrade — they keep their {held}. (rolled {total})
Actions.NowHidden: {name} slips out of sight — they are now hidden.
Actions.AlreadyHidden: Already hidden — a success finds a better spot, nothing changes.
Actions.DamageDead: {name} is murdered — cross them off the roster. ({total} vs 4+)
Actions.DamageInjury: {name} is hurt ({total}) — roll on the Injury Table.
Actions.InjuryDead: {name}'s wounds are fatal: {injury} (rolled {total}). Cross them off the roster.
Actions.DirectionResult: Moves {direction} (2d6 = {total}). On a 4+ they reach the intended area; otherwise move clockwise to the first available space.
Actions.MoveBlocked: Can't reach {direction} (2d6 = {total}) — moves clockwise to {cell} instead.
Actions.MoveStuck: No open square to move to — stays in {cell} (2d6 = {total}).
Actions.EventSafe: {name} senses hostility, but no one is around — they are safe.
Actions.EventHazard: Environmental hazard in {cell}: {hazard}! Everyone there rolls {n}+ ({save}).
Actions.EventHazardDead: {name} is killed by the {hazard} — cross them off the roster.
Actions.EventHazardStuckNote: {name} is stuck in the {hazard} — Move is blocked while they struggle free ({rounds} rounds to escape).
Actions.EventHazardTrapArmed: The {hazard} stays armed in {cell}: at the start of each round, everyone still there re-rolls the save until all have passed.
Actions.MoveStuckTrap: {name} is stuck in the {hazard} and cannot move — {rounds} round(s) left to break free.
Actions.MimicNote: Copies the exact action of another player in the area. If no one is around, or the target hasn't acted, they do nothing of value.
Actions.InLoveNote: Focused on their lover: find them, then never leave their side. Once found, all rolls gain +1.
Actions.NoPersonality: {name} has no personality set — pick one on the sheet first.
Actions.UnknownPersonality: Unknown personality "{personality}" — pick one from the sheet's list.

Overseer.Desc: You decide — choose the player's action, or roll on the random table.

Convince.Name: Convince
Convince.Desc: Convince a person to join, leave or trade.

Move.Name: Move
Move.Desc: Move to another map grid space.

Mimic.Name: Mimic
Mimic.Desc: Does an action of another player.

InLove.Name: In Love
InLove.Desc: Find, defend, and comfort their lover.

Setup.Title: Battle Royale — Game Setup
Setup.GMOnly: Only the GM can run the game setup.
Setup.GenderRedFemale: By suit — red female, black male
Setup.GenderRedMale: By suit — red male, black female
Setup.DiversityHint: 1 = very diverse, 10 = homogeneous. Each player rolls 1d10; on a roll at or above this level their name comes from another region.
Setup.ClearHint: Delete all current players (and their tokens) before dealing the new roster.
Setup.Summary: {count} players entered the arena. Primary region: {region} (diversity {diversity}).

Rounds.Title: Round Tracker
Rounds.EscalationChat: Desperation Escalation rises: Damage +{damage}, Success now {success}+.
Rounds.LethalNow: {zone} is now LETHAL — anyone still inside is dead.
Rounds.ZoneKilled: {name} is caught in {cell} as the zone is destroyed — cross them off the roster.
Rounds.TrapSweep: The {hazard} in {cell} triggers again — everyone still there rolls {n}+ ({save}).
Rounds.TrapDisarmed: The {hazard} in {cell} is spent — everyone there has passed the save.
Rounds.WarningNow: Warning: {zone} — evacuate before it turns lethal!
Rounds.NextLethal: Warned zone turns lethal at the end of round {n}
Rounds.EarlyNextConfirm: {n} player(s) haven't acted this round yet: {names}. Advance to the next round anyway?

Endgame.DecreeBody: Only {n} players remain. Zone progression halts. All non-combat actions are replaced with Attack, and a Convince becomes a Desperation Plea — a lethal social attack.
Endgame.PleaNote: Showdown: this Convince is a Desperation Plea — if it lands, the target gives up and dies.
Endgame.PleaWin: {convincer} talks {target} into giving up — they die. The kill is credited.
Endgame.ForcedMove: No one to attack in {cell} — {name} moves to {dest}, hunting the nearest player.
Endgame.ForcedMoveStuck: No one to attack in {cell} and nowhere left to go — {name} holds position.
Endgame.ForcedMoveHidden: No visible target in {cell} — {name} stalks the area but finds no one.
Endgame.ImpatienceWarning: The Overseer grows impatient: {n} rounds without a death. One more and a necklace detonates.
Endgame.Detonation: {name}'s necklace detonates — cross them off the roster.
Endgame.FinalTeamBody: Every living player is on team {team}. {name} acts first this round and must choose one person to save — the team fractures in two.
Endgame.FinalTeamPrompt: {name}, choose one teammate to save. The two of you break away from team {team}.
Endgame.FinalTeamResult: {name} chooses to save {saved} — they form team {newTeam}. {others} remain on team {team}.
Endgame.FinalTeamStale: The Final Team situation has changed — no split is needed anymore.
Endgame.ReckoningIntro: Only {a} and {b} remain. The Overseer stages one final scenario.
Endgame.ReckoningSkill: Contested skill: {skill}. Each rolls 1d6 + their bonus; a tie kills them both.
Endgame.ReckoningTie: Neither prevails ({w} to {l}). Both necklaces detonate — there are no winners.
Endgame.FinalDayConfirm: Round 30 has ended with {n} players alive. The Overseer detonates necklaces at random until only one remains. Proceed?
Endgame.FinalDayReckoning: A Final Reckoning is pending — resolve it from its chat card instead.
Endgame.SummaryNoWinner: No one survived — there is no winner.
Endgame.Victory: {name} has won the Battle Royale with {kills} kill(s)! A faint digital trumpet sounds.
Endgame.NoWinners: Every player is dead. There are no winners — only a spectacle and a story. The island falls silent.

Dispersal.Title: Starting Placement
Dispersal.Prompt: {method}: every player starts at a single location. Pick the cell, or roll one randomly.
Dispersal.PlacedScattered: {n} players are scattered across the island:
Dispersal.RollCallNote: Roll Call: release players one at a time — play a round for the active players after each release; the map's round counter starts once everyone is in.

Tokens.CleanupConfirm: Remove {n} dead player token(s) from the island?
Tokens.CleanupNone: No dead players' tokens on the island.
